finalText:
The build was silently swallowing nested config keys. `resolveRelease` in `packages/shared/config.js` merged layers with `Object.assign`, which replaces whole objects instead of blending them — so any package overriding one key inside `output` or `sourcemap` lost its siblings, and the bundle stage's completeness check caught it and aborted.

Fixed by giving it a real deep merge for nested objects, keeping later layers (overrides, then CLI flags) winning per-key instead of per-object.

Build now finishes clean: `0 errors`, still the same `5 warnings`. `verify.js` also passes, confirming the merge layers correctly even for overrides the fixture didn't ship.
